claims.text: The platform supports developing and evaluating SRE agents against live system environments containing operational failure scenarios.

evidence.quote:
🔍 Overview

SREGym is an AI-native platform to enable the design, development, and evaluation of AI agents for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). The core idea is to create live system environments for SRE agents to solve real-world SRE problems. SREGym provides a comprehensive SRE benchmark suite with a wide variety of problems for evaluating SRE agents and also for training next-generation AI agents.

![SREGym Overview](/assets/overview.png) SREGym is inspired by our prior work on AIOpsLab and ITBench. It is architectured with AI-native usability and extensibility as first-class principles. The SREGym benchmark suites contain 90 different SRE problems. It supports all the problems from AIOpsLab and ITBench, and includes new problems such as OS-level faults, metastable failures, and concurrent failures. See our [problem set](https://sregym.com/problems) for a complete list of problems.

claims.text: Jev support is disabled by default; when enabled for Codex, it reviews diagnostic tests and submissions from evidence sent to TypeSafe.

evidence.quote:
#### Optional Jev decision support

Jev is disabled by default. To enable it for Codex, set `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and run:

```bash
uv run main.py --agent codex --model gpt-5.6-luna --reasoning-effort medium \
  --problem <problem-id> --jev-model jev-latest --force-build
```

Jev reviews diagnostic tests and submissions using evidence sent to TypeSafe.

claims.text: Select the agent and problem, choose the deployment profile, and enable Jev with TYPESAFE_API_KEY plus --jev-model.

evidence.quote:
Jev is disabled by default. To enable it for Codex, set `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and run:

```bash
uv run main.py --agent codex --model gpt-5.6-luna --reasoning-effort medium \
  --problem <problem-id> --jev-model jev-latest --force-build

`--profile` controls how much infrastructure SREGym stands up. It is independent of
`--suite` — the profile selects *what gets deployed*, the suite selects *which problems run*.

| Profile | Behaviour |
|---------|-----------|
| `full` (default) | The standard stack. Use this for results you intend to compare against the leaderboard. |
| `svelte` | Additionally drops components that nothing in SREGym reads, and shortens metric retention. |

it.h1: SREGym: benchmark SRE con revisione Jev facoltativa
it.description: SREGym valuta agenti di affidabilità in ambienti attivi; Codex può usare Jev per rivedere diagnosi e invii.
it.summary: La piattaforma supporta sviluppo e valutazione di agenti SRE in sistemi funzionanti con scenari di guasti operativi. Jev è disattivato per impostazione predefinita; attivato per Codex, esamina test diagnostici e invii tramite prove mandate a TypeSafe.

sections.heading: Scopo e destinatari
sections.text: La piattaforma supporta sviluppo e valutazione di agenti SRE in sistemi funzionanti con scenari di guasti operativi.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev è disattivato per impostazione predefinita; attivato per Codex, esamina test diagnostici e invii tramite prove mandate a TypeSafe.

sections.heading: Come si usa
sections.text: Si scelgono agente, problema e profilo di distribuzione, poi si abilita Jev con TYPESAFE_API_KEY e --jev-model.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: Kind locale non supporta tutti i problemi. Il README consiglia il profilo full per confronti con la classifica.
